name_zh: 卢卡申科/白罗斯建国：后苏联威权稳定与联盟国家模式
name_en: Lukashenko/Belarus Founding: Post-Soviet Authoritarian Stability & Union State Model
description_zh: 亚历山大·卢卡申科 (1954-) 1994 年首任总统至今，以"强力稳定+苏联遗产保留+俄白联盟国家"三支柱维持政权三十年。核心治理模式：强人集权 (超级总统制/议会边缘化/司法从属) + 安全机构渗透社会 (KGB 保留苏联编制/全方位监控/反对派预防性打击) + 有限多元化放行 (私营经济保留/外资准入/互联网相对开放) + 对外平衡外交 (俄军事一体化/中欧经贸/不结盟名义)。体现 M170 后苏联威权稳定——以"强人合法性+安全机构主导+有限多元化+对外平衡"四支柱，在后帝国真空期实现政权极限生存。
description_en: Alexander Lukashenko (1954-) President since 1994, maintains regime three decades via trinity of 'strongman stability + Soviet legacy preservation + Russia-Belarus Union State'. Core governance model: strongman centralization (super-presidency/parliament marginalized/judiciary subordinated) + security apparatus penetration (KGB retains Soviet structure/omnipresent surveillance/preemptive opposition strikes) + limited pluralism tolerance (private economy retained/FDI admitted/internet relatively open) + external balancing diplomacy (Russia military integration/China-Europe economics/non-alignment nominal). Exemplifies M170 Post-Soviet Authoritarian Stability—four pillars of 'strongman legitimacy + security apparatus dominance + limited pluralism + external balancing' achieving regime extreme survival in post-imperial vacuum.
reason_zh: 白俄罗斯非单纯独裁，而是"后苏联威权稳定"精心工程：卢卡申科保留苏联工业/农业/教育/医疗体制，用"稳定换发展"叙事换取民众容忍，以联盟国家框架锁定俄安全伞与能源补贴。M170 区隔于 M161 后苏联转型(乌克兰)、M163 斯拉夫边境生存(地缘)、M171 资源民族主义强人(伊拉克)，核心在于"强人+安全机构+有限多元+外部平衡"的后帝国生存操作系统。
reason_en: Belarus not mere dictatorship but engineered 'post-Soviet authoritarian stability': Lukashenko preserves Soviet industrial/agricultural/education/healthcare systems, trades 'stability for development' narrative for public tolerance, locks Russian security umbrella & energy subsidies via Union State framework. M170 distinct from M161 Post-Soviet Transition (Ukraine), M163 Slavic Borderland Survival (geopolitical), M171 Resource Nationalist Strongman (Iraq), core: 'strongman + security apparatus + limited pluralism + external balancing' post-imperial survival OS.
steps_zh: 强人合法性建构：1994 首任总统/1996 公投超级总统制/2004 取消任期限制/2020 第六任选举，选举即合法性仪式
安全机构全域渗透：KGB 保留苏联编制/名称/权力，全方位监控/渗透/预防性拘留，反对派领袖流亡/监禁/失踪
有限多元化放行阀：集体农庄保留/国企主导但私营准入/高科技园区(明斯克高新区)免税/互联网相对开放/外资能源/零售进入
联盟国家锁定俄伞：1999 联盟国家条约/俄军基地/统一防空/能源补贴(低价油气)/军工合作，安全外包换主权让渡
2020 抗争与生存：大选舞弊/百万抗议/制裁/瑞安航班强降/反对派领袖流亡/俄军事介入承诺/政权存续，威权韧性极限测试
steps_en: Strongman legitimacy construction: 1994 1st President/1996 referendum super-presidency/2004 term limits removed/2020 6th election, elections as legitimacy rituals
Security apparatus total penetration: KGB retains Soviet structure/name/powers, omnipresent surveillance/infiltration/preemptive detention, opposition leaders exiled/imprisoned/disappeared
Limited pluralism release valve: collective farms retained/SOEs dominate but private admitted/Hi-Tech Park (Minsk) tax-free/internet relatively open/FDI in energy/retail

Union State locks Russian umbrella: 1999 Union State treaty/Russian bases/unified air defense/energy subsidies (cheap oil-gas)/defense industry cooperation, security outsourcing for sovereignty concession

2020 protests & survival: election fraud/million protests/sanctions/Ryanair forced landing/opposition leaders exiled/Russian military intervention pledge/regime survives, authoritarian resilience extreme test
expected_zh: 以"强人+安全机构+有限多元+俄伞"四支柱，在后苏联空间实现三十年零政变/零颜色革命成功/零领土丧失，为后帝国威权生存提供极限案例。
expected_en: Four pillars of 'strongman + security apparatus + limited pluralism + Russian umbrella' achieve three decades zero coups/zero successful color revolutions/zero territorial loss in post-Soviet space, providing extreme case for post-imperial authoritarian survival.
case_zh: 1994 当选→1996 公投超级总统制→2001 与俄签署联盟国家条约→2010/2015/2020 连选连任→2020 抗议/制裁/俄伞存续→2022 俄乌战争允许俄军过境/部署核武器，三十年零政变。
case_en: 1994 elected -> 1996 referendum super-presidency -> 2001 Union State treaty with Russia -> 2010/2015/2020 re-elections -> 2020 protests/sanctions/Russian umbrella holds -> 2022 allows Russian transit/nuclear deployment in Ukraine war, three decades zero coups.
intellectual_tradition: Belarusian Authoritarian Stability / Union State Model
